title: mri_label2vol
description: Converts a label or a set of labels into a volume.

labels.description: Enter the name of the label file. For multiple labels, use multiple --label flags.
labels.title: Label files

annotation.description: Surface annotation file. Use this to input annotations directly.
annotation.title: Annotation file

template.description: Template volume; the output will have the same size and geometry.
template.title: Template volume

registration.description: tkregister-style registration matrix mapping LabelXYZ to VolXYZ.
registration.title: Registration matrix

identity_flag.description: Use the identity matrix as the registration.
identity_flag.title: Identity registration flag

fill_threshold.description: Threshold for voxel fill; a value between 0 and 1.
fill_threshold.title: Fill threshold

label_vox_vol.description: Volume of each label point; default is 1mm³.
label_vox_vol.title: Label voxel volume

projection.description: Project the label along the surface normal. Type can be abs or frac.
projection.title: Projection settings

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere to use for --proj or --annot. Legal values are lh and rh.
hemisphere.title: Hemisphere

output_volume.description: Output volume in which each voxel will have the number of the label to which it is assigned.
output_volume.title: Output volume

hits_volume.description: Hit volume, a multi-frame volume with one frame per label showing the number of hits per voxel.
hits_volume.title: Hit volume

label_stat_volume.description: Map the label stats field into the volume.
label_stat_volume.title: Label stat volume

stat_threshold.description: Only use label point where stat > thresh.
stat_threshold.title: Statistical threshold

offset.description: Add offset to the segmentation numbers.
offset.title: Segmentation offset

defects.description: Creates a segmentation volume of the surface defects.
defects.title: Defects settings

native_vox2ras_flag.description: Use native voxel-to-RAS transform instead of tkregister-style.
native_vox2ras_flag.title: Native voxel-to-RAS flag
